claims.finding: Thermal Jeans fragmentation has taken place; the low ratio may come from evolving core separation or hierarchical fragmentation

claims.hypothesis: Cores in the QUARKS clumps span a range of evolutionary stages that can be separated using line richness, outflows and ionized gas
claims.experiment: Classify 1562 cores using N_line, CO outflows and H30alpha emission
claims.finding: Most cores already show star-formation signatures; starless cores are a small minority

evidence.quote: we classified cores into three categories: 127 starless, 971 warm, and 464 evolved cores

claims.hypothesis: High-mass starless cores exist in IR-bright clumps in numbers that would favour turbulent core accretion
claims.experiment: Mass of starless cores at 20 K compared with a 16 Msun threshold; virial check
claims.result: Only two starless cores exceed 16 Msun (17-21 Msun); 90% have M <= 8 Msun
claims.finding: Scarcity of candidates suggests competitive accretion-type models are more applicable; candidate count is a lower limit

evidence.quote: Two starless cores have mass exceeding 16 $M_{\odot}$, and represent high-mass candidates.

evidence.loc: 4.3 Search for candidate high-mass starless cores
evidence.quote: It is worth noting that the number of high-mass starless candidates identified here likely represents a lower limit.

claims.hypothesis: Observed linear core separation depends on source distance for physical reasons
claims.experiment: Compare separations, minimum core mass and core counts versus distance (Spearman tests)
claims.result: Linear separation grows with distance; ratio to Jeans length is weakly distance dependent
claims.finding: Distance trend is an observational effect of sensitivity and linear resolution

evidence.quote: This reflects an observational effect rather than a physical phenomenon

why_this_data.value: Evolved IR-bright clumps may harbour more massive starless cores, motivating a search beyond IR-dark clouds

evidence.quote: This finding motivates searches for high-mass starless cores not only in IR-dark clouds but also in more evolved IR-bright environments.

why_this_method.value: Core separation is used instead of mass-based Jeans mass because mass estimates carry large uncertainties

evidence.quote: core separation could serve as a more suitable proxy for analyzing fragmentation properties in clumps

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Half-beam vs one-beam minimum size for getsf: half-beam chosen to recover weaker cores for a complete fragment sample

evidence.quote: the choice of minimum size (whether half- or one-beam size) does not significantly influence the parameters (e.g., size, flux) of the extracted sources with strong emission

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Lower starless dust temperature of 10-15 K would move six cores from 8-16 Msun to above 16 Msun

evidence.loc: 4.3 Search for candidate high-mass starless cores
evidence.quote: this would shift the masses of six cores (i.e., $8-16\,M_{\odot}$ at 20 K) to values greater than 16 $M_{\odot}$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Hierarchical fragmentation (clump to subclumps to cores) as alternative to evolving core separation for the low lambda_obs/lambda_J

evidence.quote: An alternative explanation for the observed $\lambda_{\rm obs}/\lambda_{\rm J} \sim 0.2$ significantly below unity could be due to the existence of a hierarchical fragmentation mode within the clumps.

how_they_decided_enough.value: Each clump has enough cores (4 to 33, with two exceptions of 3) for fragmentation analysis

evidence.quote: our clump sample contains 4 to 33 cores, which provides rather sufficient core numbers for our following fragmentation analysis

limitations_admitted.value: A few weak continuum peaks are missed by getsf

evidence.quote: a few potential sources could be still missing

limitations_admitted.value: Core separations are lower limits owing to projection

evidence.quote: the measured core separations could represent lower limits due to projection effects

limitations_admitted.value: N_line can be underestimated for line-rich cores

evidence.quote: could be underestimated for cores having a large number of complex molecular transitions

limitations_admitted.value: Free-free emission may inflate the 1.3 mm flux and masses of 27 cores above 100 Msun

evidence.quote: The 1.3 mm flux of these 27 cores could be significantly affected by free-free emission, potentially leading to mass overestimation.

limitations_admitted.value: 1.3 mm high-resolution data trace core kernels and filter out envelope mass, so high-mass candidates are a lower limit

evidence.loc: 4.3 Search for candidate high-mass starless cores
evidence.quote: primarily trace dense kernels of cores, likely filtering out significantly their envelope mass

referee_caveats_inferred: Dust temperatures are assigned by core class rather than measured, so the 16 Msun threshold and starless counts depend on T = 20 K
Starless classification relies on N_line<=6 and absence of CO outflow and H30alpha, limited by 1 arcsec resolution and sensitivity
Virial parameters use velocity dispersions borrowed from the literature rather than QUARKS measurements
Core-scale separations are compared with clump-scale Jeans lengths built from lower-resolution ATOMS-era clump parameters
Single ALMA configuration pair (TM2+ACA); TM1 data not used so close cores below ~1 arcsec are unresolved
Distance-dependent mass completeness may bias separation statistics

code_released.value: Linemarker tool (third-party, hosted on gitee) used for line-free channel selection; no new code from this paper stated

evidence.quote: A tool for manually identifying the line-free or line-emission channels in an astronomical spectrum.
https://gitee.com/liuxunchuan/linemarker

missing_for_reproduction: Per-field line-free channel lists and Linemarker choices
Self-calibration and continuum cleaning parameters per field
Per-core line detections used for N_line, outflow and H30alpha flags
Per-clump density and temperature inputs (from another paper) for the Jeans lengths
Complete core catalogue (tables printed only as excerpts)
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Several TB of raw visibilities for 156 fields of TM2+ACA with four SPWs; roughly tens of GB per field after imaging cubes, much less for continuum-only reproduction of a few fields
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA project code and software (CASA 6.6.0, getsf) are given and the physical-parameter recipe is clear, but manual line-free channel selection, self-calibration settings and getsf configuration are not given.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Results are numeric and the project code is stated, but the manual Linemarker channel selection, self-calibration and getsf details are missing, so counts such as 1562 cores cannot be matched exactly.
